title: HPCAdvisor: A Tool for Assisting Users in Selecting HPC Resources in the Cloud
problem: Users running HPC workloads on cloud platforms must select from extensive VM type options and determine cluster sizes while considering application-specific input, making it difficult to balance performance and cost.
motivation: Cloud platforms increasingly run HPC workloads, and efficient resource selection directly impacts both performance and cost optimization.
method: HPCAdvisor assists users in defining HPC clusters by integrating application input characteristics with cloud provider VM benchmarking data. The tool leverages a major cloud provider backend to recommend appropriate VM types and cluster configurations based on both generic benchmarks and application-specific requirements.
key_novelty: The tool incorporates application input specifics into resource recommendations, extending beyond generic benchmarking data to provide personalized guidance for VM selection and cluster sizing.
contributions: HPCAdvisor tool for guided HPC cluster configuration in cloud environments
Cloud provider backend integration for practical resource selection
limitations: Specific performance improvements and cost savings metrics are not quantified in the abstract.
